publisher: Idaho Legislature and Idaho Secretary of State
supersession_scope: Supplemental observations only; the October assessment remains unchanged and no readiness wave or connector is changed.

statute.evidence_origin: coordinating agent ordinary fetch on observation date
statute.finding: Section 74-120 generally restricts agency distribution or sale of lists of persons for mailing or telephone lists and use of agency-prepared lists for those purposes, subject to exceptions. Subsection (6) excludes the specified Secretary of State corporate information list from this section.
statute.boundary: The subsection (6) exception does not establish a current product, its availability or an affirmative grant of retention, commercial use, automation or redistribution rights. The described list includes registered agents, officers and directors; person-linked information requires separate review.

business_resources.evidence_origin: coordinating agent current official page observations
business_resources.finding: Business resources and FAQ describe business search, filing and registered-agent guidance; they do not establish a current recurring business-master product or contract.
business_resources.boundary: A registered-agent address is a service address, not proof of an operating site; legal registration does not establish operating activity.

sosbiz_lists.finding: The application shell is inconclusive about list products, contents, access and terms.

public_records.finding: The former public-records route redirects to JustFOIA; a redirect is not a business bulk delivery contract or authorization to submit a request.

historical_ucc_guides.evidence_origin: coordinating agent current retrieval observations and historical indexed guide descriptions
historical_ucc_guides.finding: Historical descriptions concern UCC financing-statement filing submission, not business-entity retrieval. Current 404 responses do not prove the historical service or a current business extract exists.

registered_agent_report.finding: A recent registered-agent PDF report link was observed; its body was not requested. This cohort is excluded and does not establish a statewide business master, schema or rights.

unresolved_gates: Confirm existence, current scope and supported delivery of a recurring business product.
Review current terms, price, automation permission, privacy, retention, derived use and redistribution rights.
Verify a person-free schema, stable identifiers, status semantics, entity coverage and address roles.
Verify full and delta cadence, deletions, corrections, replay, counts and checksums.
Obtain separate explicit acquisition authorization and governed connector approval before any source query or file request.
next_action: Maintain HOLD pending separately authorized document-only review of the current product and rights.
